description: Defines the ImportMapAct class for handling import mappings specific to ACT! files within SuiteCRM, extending ImportMapOther and providing module-specific field mappings.

classes.name: ImportMapAct
classes.description: A class extending ImportMapOther, tailored for ACT! file import mappings, including properties for delimiter, enclosure, header presence, and a method for module-specific field mappings.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns default field mappings for specified modules ('Contacts', 'Leads', 'Accounts') with ACT! specific field names.
